purpose: Field contract for an append-only atomic evidence sidecar; this is not a deployed validator or a scientific dataset.

transition.lower_level_and_upper_level: source-qualified level ID, configuration, term, parity, J, energy value/unit/origin/uncertainty; preserve mixing and assignment ambiguity
transition.wavelength: value, unit, air/vacuum medium, rest/observed frame, observed/Ritz/calculated origin, conversion source/version and uncertainty
transition.component_identity: transition/component/feature type, isotope mass or explicit unresolved state, HFS F_lower/F_upper, parent feature ID, component IDs and normalization; never equate a summed feature with an individual component
transition.legacy_links: canonical physical_id AND line_id at an immutable canonical CSV hash; ID alone is not proof of identical physical levels

evidence_record.underlying_origin: For evaluated: experimental/theoretical/astrophysical/mixed/unknown plus IDs of the original evidence; otherwise equals origin. Evaluation never erases underlying nature.
evidence_record.theoretical_method: For theoretical or evaluated-underlying-theoretical: method family (MCDHF/RCI, MCHF, CI, orthogonal-operator, other), code/version/commit, correlation/configuration expansion, relativistic treatment, gauge, observed-level substitutions and their source IDs. Null with reason for non-theoretical evidence.
evidence_record.source: primary DOI or explicit DOI_UNAVAILABLE with reason and stable bibcode/catalog/URL; bibliography key, table/row, original reference code, aggregator/release/query, retrieval UTC and source artifact SHA256. Preserve full parent-source chain and license.
evidence_record.quality: assessment state CANDIDATE/BENCHMARKED/REVIEWED/REJECTED/UNKNOWN; diagnostics and limitations; nist_evaluation null or exact published accuracy code (including prime), ASD release, TP reference and row evidence. MQ measurement quality is stored only in observation records. No local NIST letter assignment.
evidence_record.uncertainty: status REPORTED/ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE; absolute/relative/asymmetric representation, native units, finite positive bounds when known, distribution, confidence/coverage definition, systematic groups, derivation and source. Native percentage accuracy is not automatically 1-sigma Gaussian. Any loggf conversion retains native bounds and convention.
evidence_record.covariance_block_id: Reference to an immutable block or an explicit UNKNOWN block; never assume independence from different citations alone
evidence_record.calculation: For theory: immutable input/output manifests with hashes, executable and environment/container versions, exact CLI, numerics, convergence sequence, gauge comparison, observed-energy substitutions, blind benchmark partition/hash and report IDs, independent-method comparison, failures and rejected candidates. No Solar-abundance fitting.
evidence_record.version: immutable evidence version, content hash, created UTC, supersedes IDs and correction reason; retraction retains prior bytes

covariance_block.matrix_artifact: When known: URI plus SHA256, finite symmetric PSD matrix, dimensions matching unique ordered IDs, diagonal matching the same uncertainty convention; include cross-transition shared lifetimes/branching fractions, scale and calculation errors. UNKNOWN retains null matrix and materiality/hold reason.
covariance_block.assumptions: Explicit independence or shared-error model, confidence convention, reviewer and scope; neither zero-fill nor sigma/sqrt(N) for a shared scale

adoption_decision.adopted_evidence_id: Exactly one existing eligible evidence ID or null with HOLD; does not overwrite alternatives or legacy adopted gf
adoption_decision.rationale: Physical identity, source suitability, conflicts, uncertainty, covariance and benchmark evidence; no selection by Solar-abundance proximity
adoption_decision.review: named scientific reviewer, UTC, decision URI, input/output hashes and scope (schema/benchmark/adoption/measurement/publication); an approval for one scope confers no other approval

line_selection.legacy_grade: Preserve the exact current emitted label and selector/line_set/tier; do not infer origin from that label
line_selection.reference_memberships: Independent list of published set/version, source-used/rejected status, published gf evidence ID and lineage. Distinguish AGSS21 replication, other published sets, full-lab-pool Reference variant and evaluated amalgamation.
line_selection.depth_record: feature ID, component window and rule, value or UNKNOWN, Solar holding/instrument and spectrum hash, measured/predicted basis, generator version; below-observability stays a separate flag
line_selection.proposed_memberships: Separate CODEX/DEEP/THEORETICAL_CODEX proposals with CANDIDATE/HOLD/APPROVED/REJECTED, policy version and review. v0 approves none. Theory approval must never confer experimental origin or primary-lab membership.

eligibility.reasons: Identity, depth/route, blends, isotope/HFS, correction/normalization state, verified IR tellurics for exact product, model coverage, magnetic/pressure/molecular applicability and fit validity. A failed observation never downgrades intrinsic atomic evidence.
eligibility.publication: ELIGIBLE is measurement-only. Abundance publication separately invokes existing RYA-587 uncertainty and product eligibility contracts plus explicit human publication approval.

invariants: No production imports, classifier edits, canonical writes, feed updates, website changes or adopted theoretical values in v0.
Match species/ion plus wavelength medium/frame plus level/EP/J and isotope/HFS/component identity. Ambiguity or missing required identity is HOLD, never nearest-wavelength selection.
A cited NIST evaluation of theory is retained as an evaluated accuracy assessment, never an experimental pedigree.

Internal convergence or gauge agreement alone cannot qualify a theoretical value. Blind primary experimental benchmarks and uncertainty review are required; thresholds must be predeclared and approved before inspecting withheld results.
Separate collision, photoionization, Stark/van der Waals/ABO and NLTE-atom completeness evidence domains; a loggf benchmark does not validate them.
Propagate accepted line-data covariance through the existing RYA-587 transition-data component using product response weights; preserve matched Sun/target covariance for differential products.
Version schema, evidence, calculation, policy, adoption and scientific products separately; retain rejected candidates and immutable historical source values.
